kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتأسلم (form IIq)
# نَتَأَسْلَمُ (nataʔaslamu) /na.ta.ʔas.la.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَأَسْلَمَ (taʔaslama)
# نَتَأَسْلَمَ (nataʔaslama) /na.ta.ʔas.la.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَأَسْلَمَ (taʔaslama)
# نَتَأَسْلَمْ (nataʔaslam) /na.ta.ʔas.lam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَأَسْلَمَ (taʔaslama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
